# A differential corpus: each line is an expression, what ClusterShell expands
# it to (the host names, or "error", or "-" for none), and, where clusterctl
# decides otherwise on purpose, the divergence doc/nodeset.md lists for it.
# Columns are separated by one tab. clustershell.py rewrites the second column.
# Recorded with ClusterShell 1.10.1.
exe1	exe1
exe0001	exe0001
login	login
exe[1-3]	exe1 exe2 exe3
exe[0001-0003]	exe0001 exe0002 exe0003
exe[1-10/3]	exe1 exe4 exe7 exe10
exe[1,5,9]	exe1 exe5 exe9
exe[09-11]	exe09 exe10 exe11
exe[01-100/33]	error	padding mismatch
exe[1-2]-ib[0-1]	exe1-ib0 exe1-ib1 exe2-ib0 exe2-ib1
rack[1-2]node[01-02]	rack1node01 rack1node02 rack2node01 rack2node02
exe[1-2].hpc.example.org	exe1.hpc.example.org exe2.hpc.example.org
10.0.1.[1-4]	10.0.1.1 10.0.1.2 10.0.1.3 10.0.1.4
exe[1-3],sub[1-2]	exe1 exe2 exe3 sub1 sub2
exe[1-5]!exe[2-3]	exe1 exe4 exe5
exe[1-5]&exe[4-8]	exe4 exe5
exe[1-3]^exe[2-4]	exe1 exe4
exe[1-3]!exe2,sub1	exe1 exe3 sub1
exe[1-10]!exe[1-5]&exe[1-7]	exe6 exe7
exe[08-10]!exe09	exe08 exe10
exe[1-3],exe[2-5]	exe1 exe2 exe3 exe4 exe5
exe[0001-0010]!exe[0002-0009]	exe0001 exe0010
x[1-2]y[01-02]!x1y02	x1y01 x2y01 x2y02
exe[1-5]!exe[1-5]	-
exe[	error
exe1]	error
exe[]	error
exe[5-1]	error
exe[1-2/0]	error
exe[a-b]	error
exe[3/2]	error
exe[1,,2]	error
exe[1-3]&	error
exe[1-3]!	error
exe[1-3]^	error
exe[1-3]!,exe2	error
exe[1-3]&&exe2	error
exe[1-3]&!exe2	error
exe[1-3],&exe2	error
&exe1	error
!exe1	error
exe1,exe01	exe1 exe01	padding identity
exe01,exe1	exe1 exe01	padding identity
exe[1,01]	exe1 exe01	padding identity
exe[01-02],exe3	exe3 exe01 exe02
exe[1-3]!exe02	exe1 exe2 exe3	padding identity
exe0[0,10]	exe00 exe010	adjacent numeric parts
exe[1-2][3-4]	error
exe[1-010]	error
exe[01-100]	error	padding mismatch
exe[001-10]	error
exe[1-3] sub1	exe1 sub1 exe2 sub1 exe3 sub1	whitespace
exe1 & exe[1-2]	exe1
exe[1-3],	error	empty operand
exe[1-3],,exe5	error	empty operand
,exe1	error	empty operand
-oProxyCommand=x	-oProxyCommand=x	leading dash
exe1,-exe2	-exe2 exe1	leading dash
